summary: The Jetta M6, starting at 79,800 yuan, brings urban NOA into the sub-100,000-yuan segment, while new-energy vehicles have surpassed 60% of new car sales for three consecutive months, accelerating the penetration of both smart and electric technologies.

articles.title: Jetta M6 Launches: Urban NOA + 555 km Range, Priced from 79,800 Yuan
articles.summary: The Jetta M6 launches with an urban NOA smart-driving system and 555 km of range, starting at 79,800 yuan, resetting the bar for the entry-level EV market.
articles.detail: Jetta's all-new M6 model has officially gone on sale with an official guide price starting at 79,800 yuan. The car's biggest highlight is its urban NOA advanced driver-assistance capability, which — combined with a 555 km range — brings a feature once common only in vehicles priced above 150,000 yuan into the 80,000-yuan segment. In product terms, the Jetta M6 targets first-time buyers and those looking to upgrade or replace their cars who are price-sensitive yet still expect a smart driving experience. The vehicle topped Baidu's trending searches on its launch day, making it the most-followed automotive topic of the day. Against a backdrop where new-energy vehicles have accounted for more than 60% of new car sales for three consecutive months, a joint-venture brand entering the mainstream EV market with such aggressive pricing and driver-assistance specs underscores Jetta's clear intent to trade value for market share in its new-energy transition.
articles.impact: Urban NOA appearing in the 80,000-yuan segment for the first time will force rivals at the same price point to close their smart-driving gaps and accelerate the roll-out of advanced driver assistance in the entry-level market.

articles.title: BAIC Star Armor 5X Opens Pre-Sales from RMB 139,900: BEV/PHEV Options and Qiankun ADAS
articles.summary: The BAIC Star Armor 5X starts pre-sales at RMB 139,900, offering both battery-electric and plug-in hybrid powertrains, with the Qiankun smart-driving system standard across the lineup.
articles.detail: BAIC has officially launched pre-sales for the Star Armor 5X, with a starting price of RMB 139,900. The new model offers both fully electric and plug-in hybrid powertrains to cover users with different charging conditions, and comes equipped with Huawei's Qiankun intelligent driving system, making it one of the few vehicles under RMB 150,000 to offer an advanced ADAS solution. The dual powertrain strategy, combined with a mature smart-driving ecosystem partnership, reflects BAIC's playbook in the mainstream NEV price band: broadening its customer base through powertrain flexibility while leveraging Qiankun's brand endorsement to lift product pricing power. The pre-sale price range also cuts directly into the fiercely competitive compact NEV SUV segment, going head-to-head with key models from BYD, Geely and Changan.
articles.impact: Qiankun smart driving dipping below the RMB 140,000 mark will further lower the entry barrier for advanced ADAS, widening the gap with joint-venture brands on driver-assistance features.

articles.title: Lynk & Co 900L Spied: Seven-Seat Option, Extended Range, Two-Tone Paint and Disc-Style Wheels Available
articles.summary: Details of a new Lynk & Co 900L variant have emerged, revealing a seven-seat layout, improved driving range, and optional two-tone bodywork with retro disc-style wheels.
articles.detail: Information on the long-wheelbase Lynk & Co 900L, an extended version of the 900 series, has been leaked. Based on the available details, the new model will offer a seven-seat configuration to better serve families with multiple passengers, and delivers improved range compared with the current version. On the styling front, the 900L offers optional two-tone paint and retro-inspired disc-style wheels to enhance personalization and premium appeal. The combination of seven seats and longer range signals Lynk & Co's intent to expand the 900 series from a large five-seat flagship into a full-size family flagship, directly taking on six- and seven-seat range-extended and battery-electric flagships from Li Auto, AITO and others. With the RMB 300,000-class large NEV SUV market continuing to expand, seat count and range remain the two most direct levers for winning over family buyers.
articles.impact: Entering the large-SUV family segment with seven seats and extended range will intensify competition among NEV flagships in the RMB 300,000 class, pushing product competition in the segment even further.

articles.title: All-New BYD Seagull Trade-In Price from RMB 62,900: Bigger Body, Second-Gen Blade Battery
articles.summary: The all-new BYD Seagull is offered at a trade-in price from RMB 62,900, featuring a larger body and BYD's second-generation Blade Battery.
articles.detail: BYD has launched the all-new Seagull at a trade-in price starting from RMB 62,900. The new model features increased body dimensions for improved interior space, and is equipped with BYD's second-generation Blade Battery, offering upgrades in safety and energy density over its predecessor. As BYD's volume-driving model in the A0-class battery-electric market, the Seagull's generational change directly affects BYD's share of the entry-level BEV segment. A trade-in price in the low RMB 60,000s, paired with upgrades to both size and battery, effectively pushes competition in the micro and small BEV markets to its limit. With the all-new Seagull and the Jetta M6 being revealed or launched on the same day, the sub-RMB 80,000 BEV market is fast becoming the next high-intensity price band after the compact segment.
articles.impact: Leading automakers continuing to press down into the entry market with battery technology and space upgrades will further squeeze the生存空间 of second-tier brands' A0-class BEV models.

articles.title: Changan's Jiang Ping: No High- or Low-Trim Safety Tiers — Safety Tech Should Be Accessible to All
articles.summary: Changan's Jiang Ping said safety features should not be tiered by trim level, pledging to make safety technology standard across the automaker's full lineup.
articles.detail: In an exclusive interview, Changan Automobile's Jiang Ping said that safety cannot be divided into high- and low-trim tiers, and that Changan's goal is to make safety technology universally accessible. The statement implies that Changan will roll out safety technology across models at different price points and segments, rather than limiting it to higher trims or premium brands. Against the backdrop of an increasingly fierce NEV market competition, with some automakers trading off features for pricing advantages, Changan's positioning of safety as a uniform standard regardless of price represents a differentiated brand value proposition. As consumers place greater emphasis on battery safety and active safety, safety is evolving from a marketing talking point into one of the core factors in purchase decisions, and automakers that commit to lineup-wide safety standards first stand to build long-term trust equity.
articles.impact: If implemented, a lineup-wide commitment to equal safety standards could steer the industry from price wars toward value competition, pressuring rivals to make safety features standard across their ranges.

articles.title: Audi China Names First Chinese-Born President, Deepening Localization Strategy
articles.summary: Audi China has appointed its first Chinese-born president, marking a key step in localizing its leadership team in the country.
articles.detail: Audi China has named its first Chinese-born president, a move that trended on Baidu. Placing local talent at the helm of its China operations is a significant signal of deeper localization for a multinational luxury brand in the Chinese market. In recent years, German luxury automakers in China have faced simultaneous pressure from domestic premium new-energy brands and EV startups, reshaping the competitive landscape. A Chinese executive leading the charge means Audi will move closer to the real needs of Chinese consumers in product positioning, channel operations and partnership ecosystems, while decision-making chains are also expected to shorten. The personnel change comes against a backdrop in which luxury brands broadly need to respond faster to the pace of change in China's new-energy vehicle market.
articles.impact: The accelerated localization of foreign luxury brands' China management could help them respond more nimbly to the Chinese market and may trigger a ripple effect of organizational restructuring among other multinational automakers in China.

articles.title: CATL Builds New Electric Heavy-Truck Ecosystem: Battery-to-Battery Range Extension Plus Qiji Battery Swapping
articles.summary: CATL has unveiled a comprehensive electric heavy-truck solution that combines battery-to-battery range extension with the Qiji battery-swapping network, creating a new ecosystem for truck electrification.
articles.detail: CATL has rolled out a new ecosystem for electric heavy trucks, with core technologies including a battery-to-battery range extension system and the Qiji battery-swapping network. Heavy-truck electrification has long been constrained by three factors: driving range, refueling/recharging efficiency and purchase costs. Battery-to-battery range extension boosts overall range through coordinated power delivery among multiple battery packs, while Qiji battery swapping addresses downtime on trunk logistics routes through a standardized swapping model. Together, they are expected to significantly improve the operating economics of electric heavy trucks. CATL's move signals its ambition to evolve from a single battery supplier into a provider of integrated electrification solutions and energy services, covering the full operational lifecycle of commercial vehicles. As the logistics industry pursues cost reduction and efficiency gains amid tightening carbon constraints, heavy-truck electrification is seen as the next incremental market for power battery makers.
articles.impact: If the combined swapping and range-extension approach scales up, it will lower the barrier for logistics companies to electrify and push the diesel-to-electric transition of heavy trucks into a phase of meaningful volume growth.

articles.title: Chery's 2026 Global Innovation Conference Showcases Full Slate of Breakthrough Technologies
articles.summary: The 2026 Chery Global Innovation Conference presented a wide array of innovations spanning intelligence, electrification and frontier technologies.
articles.detail: The 2026 Chery Global Innovation Conference was held, showcasing a concentrated display of innovative technologies and achievements. According to a summary of key highlights, Chery has built systematic capabilities in areas such as intelligent features and electrification, and released a large volume of technical information at the event. Notably, Chery went beyond its core auto business to present cross-sector initiatives including agricultural robotics; executive Han Wei spoke at the conference about the value of such robots for food security. Using a global innovation conference as a stage for a concentrated technology showcase is a typical playbook for leading Chinese automakers to demonstrate R&D strength and engage with global supply-chain resources — and it reflects Chinese carmakers' shift from exporting products to exporting technology and ecosystems.
articles.impact: Systematically presenting R&D achievements through a technology conference helps strengthen Chinese brands' influence and ability to command a technology premium within the global supply chain.

articles.title: NEV Share of New Car Sales Tops 60% for Third Straight Month as Dominance Deepens
articles.summary: New energy vehicles have exceeded 60% of new car sales for three consecutive months, further consolidating their dominant market position.
articles.detail: Data shows that the NEV share of new car sales has surpassed 60% for three straight months, signaling that the replacement of internal combustion vehicles is entering an accelerated phase. On the supply side, launches such as the Jetta M6 priced from 79,800 yuan, the all-new Seagull defending the A0 segment at a 62,900 yuan trade-in price, and the BAIC Xingta 5X and Lynk & Co 900L flooding the mainstream-to-premium segments show that virtually all new models are launched exclusively as NEVs — a fundamental shift in supply structure that explains the steadily rising share. A combination of lower price points, longer range and broader availability of advanced driver-assistance systems gives NEV models a competitive edge over equivalent ICE rivals across all price brackets.
articles.impact: A 60% share could become the new normal for the NEV market. ICE vehicle share will continue to shrink, reshaping dealership networks, the used-car market and the aftermarket landscape.

articles.title: Smart Driving Follows Moore's Law With Tenfold Annual Gains; 2028 May Mark L4 Commercialization Tipping Point
articles.summary: Intelligent driving capabilities are growing at a Moore's Law pace, improving tenfold per year, with the industry expecting an L4-level inflection point in 2028.
articles.detail: Industry observers say intelligent driving capabilities are advancing at a Moore's Law trajectory — roughly tenfold improvement per year — and expect 2028 to become the key inflection point for Level 4 autonomous driving. The basis for this view: urban NOA is rapidly trickling down to 100,000-yuan-class vehicles such as the Jetta M6, while mature solutions like Huawei's QianKun intelligent driving have entered the sub-150,000-yuan segment in models like the BAIC Xingta 5X. The scaled deployment of smart driving is providing abundant training data for algorithm and data flywheels, while falling hardware costs and rising computing power create a positive feedback loop that accelerates capability iteration. If the L4 tipping point arrives as expected, business models in mobility services and commercial logistics will undergo fundamental change.
articles.impact: As the gap between smart driving capability and cost narrows, valuation logic for automakers will be reshaped, with data and algorithm capabilities becoming the core competitive moat.

articles.title: Smart Driving and Safety Go Mainstream: 100,000-Yuan Segment Enters New Era of Value War
articles.summary: City NOA is descending to the 80,000-yuan level and safety tech is no longer tiered by trim — competition in the entry-level market is shifting from price cuts to feature parity.
articles.detail: A clear thread runs through today's news: features once reserved for premium vehicles are rapidly trickling down to the entry segment. The Jetta M6 offers city NOA and 555 km of range at 79,800 yuan, the BAIC Star Tan 5X delivers Qiankun smart driving at 139,900 yuan, and Chang'an has explicitly championed safety technology across all trim levels. Looking ahead, new cars priced between 80,000 and 150,000 yuan that lack advanced smart driving or comprehensive safety features will struggle to compete at the dealership. For consumers, the same budget will keep buying more intelligence and safety. For automakers, hardware stuffing is no longer a moat — systematic cost control and data capabilities are.
articles.impact: The entry market is shifting from a price war to a feature-parity war, benefiting consumers while accelerating the exit of weaker brands that lack technology integration capabilities.

articles.title: Chery Bets on AI Transformation as Automakers Expand Into Smart Tech Ecosystems
articles.summary: Chery aims to become an AI-driven smart technology company, opening new growth curves through cross-sector ventures such as agricultural robotics.
articles.detail: Chery executive Gao Xinhua said the company is committed to becoming an AI-driven smart technology company. At the 2026 Chery Global Innovation Conference, the automaker also showcased agricultural robots and other products beyond its core automotive business, with Han Wei outlining the value of agricultural robotics for food security. This positioning and strategy reflect the transformation path of leading Chinese automakers: making AI a core capability and reusing perception, decision-making and control technologies developed on smart EVs across a wider range of intelligent equipment scenarios. Combined with CATL's expansion from battery supplier into an energy ecosystem for electric heavy trucks, the boundaries of the auto industry are being redefined — future competition will hinge on ecosystems and the ability to reuse technology.
articles.impact: Automakers' pivot into AI technology companies could lift their valuation ceilings, with technology-reuse businesses poised to become the second growth curve after vehicle sales.
